label: Peplink B One
description: Small-business SD-WAN router: 2x GE WAN, 4x GE LAN, 1 Gbps routing throughput, Wi-Fi 6 for the wireless variant.
notes: Vendor figures from the Peplink tech-spec sheet: **2 GE WAN and 4 GE LAN**, router throughput 1 Gbps. The two WAN ports are modelled separately as wan1 and wan2 because a second WAN is the reason this line exists - failover between two uplinks is the feature a branch buys it for. The per-band Wi-Fi rows were not extracted, so the two radios carry the AX1800 class figures (574M / 1.2G) and should be read as class rather than a quoted row.
